findings.location: EARS.01.03.eca5 — Capacity-utilization alert (WITHIN the capacity-monitoring envelope)
findings.message: The utilization level is bound by @threshold: PRD.01.quota.codespacecapacity, but the WITHIN timing bound 'the capacity-monitoring envelope' (how soon after crossing the threshold the alert must be emitted) carries no @threshold tag or named-ADR deferral marker of its own. The present threshold governs the utilization level, not the alert-emit latency, so an engineer could read the alert-cadence bound as resolved when it is actually an unstated/deferred timing bound.
findings.recommendation: Attach an explicit threshold or named-ADR deferral marker for the alert-emit timing envelope (e.g. a @threshold for capacity-monitoring alert latency, or name the owning ADR topic for the alert cadence) so the timing bound is unambiguously deferred rather than implicitly resolved by the utilization-level threshold.
